tier2_explanatory.short_meaning: God is my oath; God is abundance
tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Elisheva: Eli, 'my God', + sheva, 'oath' or 'seven'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-sh-b-ʿ. Elizabeth, mother of John the Baptist (Luke 1). Elizabeth is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my oath; God is abundance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
